notes.title: Look, a new game! My Hidden... Dreams.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752445/be22e4b6a0a0fcd32af0006ac1707015d1993aba.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce the release of the new installment of "My Hidden Dreams"! This time, you will enjoy 8 brand-new stories, each immersing you in a unique world with captivating characters and plots.

We’ve significantly improved the graphics compared to the first game, delivering an even more engaging experience. Additionally, beautiful comic strips are included to provide deeper insight into the story and characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752445/9c923a8d9788838d47b184302f4741732a5366f5.jpg[/img]

New levels bring exciting and diverse challenges that will require your cleverness and attention to detail.

Don’t miss the chance to dive back into the world of dreams and uncover new adventures in "My Hidden Dreams"! [u]Thank you for wishlist! [/u]

[b]Game link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104880/My_Hidden_Dreams]My Hidden Dreams[/url][/b]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Hi!
It's time for the most magical time of the year and our team would like to wish everyone a Merry Christmas. During the holidays it is usual to be near people closest to you and we wish that each of you’ll always meet the cold winter time in the circle of your friends or loved ones.

We hope that everyone will feel a little bit of happiness today, and that future will shine with the colors of a promising tomorrow. We wish you a Merry Christmas.

My Hidden Things team.

notes.title: Update! 3 new levels are available for free!
notes.notes:
Maria, a woman who plays in the theater, does not get the role she wanted ... How will this turn out for her and the other actress? We made this 3-level add-on for free and also fixed a lot of bugs. [b] Thank you for being with us! [/ b]

[list]
[*] Immerse yourself in the dreams of a girl dreaming of fame.
[*] Explore 3 new levels.
[*] Several important bugs have been fixed.
[/ list]

notes.title: Relax to the music from My Hidden Things!
notes.notes:
If you liked the music in the game and want to support our musicians, now you can do it by purchasing the official My Hidden Things soundtrack.
Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Simplified Chinese added, minor bugs fixed.
notes.notes:
Thank you JJ for translating into simplified Chinese!
- Fixed some buttons.
- Items at Miya level are going a little easier.

notes.title: Update! Added minor bug fixes and Portuguese translation.
notes.notes: We added the Portuguese language to the game. Thiago "Thitz" Mania helped make the translation. Thanks to him! We will be glad to see reviews in this beautiful language. Also, minor bugs with finding items were fixed.

notes.title: The work on the new patch is in full swing!
notes.notes:
Hello! Ophelia Level 2 sometimes behaves strangely. I don’t understand why it contains bugs, it was created just like everyone else ... If you experience difficulties with it, then reboot it, and I will try to find the reason for this behavior ...

We want to share the adventure of Ksari and you with the whole world. The main task of our team now is to make the game accessible to a large number of players and fix bugs. At the moment, we are working on translations into Portuguese and Chinese. But if you know someone who can help us with translation into other languages, we will be happy. Our contact sixdotsstudio@gmail.com
